text:
The abstract clearly supports a model where iron‑rich, silica‑ and aluminium‑poor ultrabasic melts are produced by interaction of silicate magmas with oxidized, P‑F‑SO₄‑bearing sedimentary rocks, and these melts crystallise to form magnetite‑apatite ores. This matches Hypothesis 1, while Hypotheses 2‑4 introduce conditions (low fO₂, U‑Th depletion, Pb‑rich metasomatic fluids, distinct temperature/pressure regimes, emphasis on fluid‑driven processes) that are not reflected in the presented evidence.

VERDICT 1: ACCEPT  
VERDICT 2: REJECT  
VERDICT 3: REJECT  
VERDICT 4: REJECT
